ui_bugs.issue: Cart is WIPED on page reload/refresh. Reproduction: add an item on /commander → navigate to /panier (works via SPA nav) → press F5 (browser reload). After reload, cart shows 'Votre panier est vide' AND localStorage.angel_cart_v1 is overwritten to '{"restaurant":[],"epicerie":[]}'. Root cause: two useEffect hooks race in CartProvider — the hydration effect (reads localStorage) calls setCart(saved) but the persistence effect (writes cart to localStorage) also fires on mount with the initial empty state closure and OVERWRITES localStorage before the loaded state re-renders it back. Impact: any user hard-reloading the site loses their entire cart (also happens after browser tab reopen). This becomes especially painful now that /panier is a dedicated page users may refresh.

issues: Radix a11y warning still present: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on some modals. Already noted in iteration_1; low priority.

action_items: Fix cart-wipe-on-reload bug in /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.js. Recommended fix (2 lines): switch to lazy useState initializers so localStorage is read synchronously BEFORE any useEffect fires. Example: const [cart, setCart] = useState(() => { try { const c = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || 'null'); return c && typeof c === 'object' ? c : { restaurant: [], epicerie: [] }; } catch { return { restaurant: [], epicerie: [] }; } }); Same for mode. Then remove the hydration useEffect entirely. This eliminates the write-empty-before-read race.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby=undefined explicit ignore) on remaining Dialogs (checkout-modal, product-modal) to silence Radix a11y warnings.

rca of the issue: BUG: Cart wiped on page refresh. RCA: /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.js declares two useEffects. useEffect#1 (line 13-20, deps []) reads localStorage and calls setCart(saved). useEffect#2 (line 22, deps [cart]) writes cart to localStorage. After first mount both effects run in declaration order but BOTH use the same closure over the initial empty cart. Effect#1 schedules a state update via setCart(saved) but does NOT synchronously mutate `cart`. Effect#2, running next, sees the still-initial empty cart and writes it to localStorage — overwriting saved data. React then re-renders with the loaded state and effect#2 re-runs to restore correct data — but if the user visits a route that reads cart on first render (like /panier's Cart.jsx which computes `bothEmpty` immediately), they will briefly see 'Votre panier est vide' and, worse, if another tab reads localStorage during the empty window, it observes empty. Reproduction verified in this iteration. Mitigation: switch to lazy useState initializer so cart is loaded on first render before any effect fires, then keep only the persistence effect.
